what_happened.line: The Finance Committee voted 4-0 on a roll call to recommend raising the capital project threshold in the town's capital plan fiscal policy.
The town manager said few future projects fall under the new threshold and the public facilities line can absorb them with more long-term planning.
A member asked for reporting to the committee on grant and other spending over a threshold that is outside the omnibus budget.
The committee asked the town manager and finance director to explain the year-end and unbudgeted spending process at a future meeting.
The town manager reported a small net state aid increase in the Senate budget over the Governor's estimates, and an expected rise in trash bag prices after a sole hauling bid.

why_it_matters: A higher capital threshold changes which purchases go through the capital plan and Town Meeting and which are paid from operating lines such as public facilities.
Reporting on unbudgeted and year-end spending would show residents spending that never appears in the budget voted at Town Meeting.
Trash bag prices are expected to rise after the hauling award, a cost residents who buy the bags would pay directly.
